![Placeholder: A lineup of the nine core classes in iconic poses: Protector, Blade, Arcanist, Shepherd, Intellect, Odd, Leader, Unbalanced, and Shadow.](../assets/images/placeholder-ch05-classes.png){width=80%}


{{< pagebreak >}}

Your class is your hero's calling. It's not a job, it's who you are when the torches gutter and the door slams shut behind you. Nine classes. Nine ways to face the darkness. Pick the one that makes you grin.

::: {.callout-note}
## Classes Shape Costs, Not Limits

Your class gives you a Discipline, a signature ability, and cheaper access to certain skills and Disciplines. It does not restrict what you can buy, only what comes easily. A Protector who studies Arcana pays more for it. That's the point. Be unusual, just know it'll cost you.
:::

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Class Overview

| Class | Role | L1 Discipline | Signature |
|-------|------|--------------|-----------|
| **Protector** | Tank, defender | Armor | **Bastion**, defensive stance |
| **Blade** | Assassin, precision | Blades | **Swift Blade** |
| **Arcanist** | Arcane caster | Energy | **Arcane Shield** |
| **Shepherd** | Divine guide | Protection | **Turn Undead** |
| **Intellect** | Scholar, strategist | Any one | **Knowledge Is Power** |
| **Odd** | Chaos wildcard | Any one (different category) | **Eccentric Spellcasting** |
| **Leader** | Commander | Protection | **Lead by Example** |
| **Unbalanced** | High-risk power | Any Elemental | **Edge of Chaos** |
| **Shadow** | Sneak thief, infiltrator | Blades | **Vanish** |

## The Protector

*"Stand behind me."*

The Protector stands at the vanguard, using body and armor as a shield for those in their care. You are the anchor, built on Brawn and Fortitude, trained to absorb blows that would fell lesser heroes. Your pride is not in the enemies you slay but in the allies who walk away unharmed because you stood in the gap. You pursue ever-better ways to fortify your resilience while keeping the ability to strike back when needed.

**Class Discipline (L1):** Armor (1)

**Signature, Bastion:** Spend your movement to enter a defensive stance. Add +1 to your Protection Value for the round. At higher levels, this bonus increases.

**Favored Skills:** Athletics, Endurance, Intimidation, Resilience, Blades skills, Axes skills, Polearms, Hammers skills, Armor, Shields, Unarmed Fighting

**Discipline Costs (Rank 1 / Rank 2 / Rank 3):**

| Discipline | Cost | Discipline | Cost |
|------------|------|------------|------|
| Fire | 4/8/16 | Protection | 1/2/4 |
| Earth | 4/8/16 | Armor | 1/2/4 |
| Wind | 4/8/16 | Animal | 3/6/12 |
| Water | 4/8/16 | Plants | 4/8/16 |
| Blades | 1/2/4 | Energy | 4/8/16 |
| Axes | 1/2/4 | Life | 4/8/16 |
| Polearms | 1/2/4 | Religion | 4/8/16 |
| Archery | 2/4/8 | Mind | 4/8/16 |
| Heavy Weapon | 1/2/4 | Summon | 4/8/16 |
| Unarmed | 1/2/4 | | |

::: {.callout-note}
## The Protector's Mindset

You're not "the boring one." You're the reason the Blade gets to do their job without dying. Position yourself between the monster and the squishy people. Make the DA attack you, you can take it. When you raise your shield, everyone behind it breathes easier.
:::

{{< pagebreak >}}

## The Blade

*"Strike once. Strike true. Strike last."*

The Blade masters the art of finesse and precision, favoring the swift elegance of light blades. Your expertise lies in meticulously placed stabs, exploiting vulnerabilities with the sharpness and agility of your weapons. Keyed to Guile, you weave through the battlefield, striking with calculated precision, each strike as effective as it is lethal. You are the shadow on the wall, the final face your enemies see.

**Class Discipline (L1):** Blades (1)

**Signature, Swift Blade:** You may use Agility instead of Brawn when attacking with blades. Gain the **Precise Stab** ability, bonus damage when exploiting an opening.

**Favored Skills:** Acrobatics, Deception, Perception, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Blades skills, Bow Fighting, Thrown Weapon, Unarmed Fighting

**Discipline Costs (Rank 1 / Rank 2 / Rank 3):**

| Discipline | Cost | Discipline | Cost |
|------------|------|------------|------|
| Fire | 4/8/16 | Protection | 3/6/12 |
| Earth | 4/8/16 | Armor | 4/8/16 |
| Wind | 4/8/16 | Animal | 4/8/16 |
| Water | 4/8/16 | Plants | 4/8/16 |
| Blades | 1/2/4 | Energy | 4/8/16 |
| Axes | 4/8/16 | Life | 4/8/16 |
| Polearms | 2/4/8 | Religion | 4/8/16 |
| Archery | 1/2/4 | Mind | 4/8/16 |
| Heavy Weapon | 4/8/16 | Summon | 4/8/16 |
| Unarmed | 1/2/4 | | |

::: {.callout-note}
## The Blade's Mindset

A Blade doesn't trade blows, they choose the moment, the angle, the vulnerability, then strike once. If the fight is fair, you've already made a mistake. Use positioning, surprise, and your allies' distractions to create openings. Your damage comes from precision, not brute force.
:::

## The Arcanist

*"Fire answers to me."*

The Arcanist delves into the mysteries of arcane energies, mastering their manipulation to bend the fabric of reality. Your focus is harnessing these powerful forces, channeling them into spells that devastate foes and alter the course of battle. Keyed to Knowledge, you weave complex incantations with deep understanding, summoning energies that shimmer with potential. Every spell fires. Every single one. The question is never *if*, only how well.

**Class Discipline (L1):** Energy (1)

**Signature, Arcane Shield:** As a free action, raise a protective ward that increases your defense roll by +1 for the round. At higher levels, this shield grows stronger. Once per round.

**Favored Skills:** Alchemy, Arcana, History, Investigation, Lore (any)

**Discipline Costs (Rank 1 / Rank 2 / Rank 3):**

| Discipline | Cost | Discipline | Cost |
|------------|------|------------|------|
| Fire | 1/2/4 | Protection | 4/8/16 |
| Earth | 1/2/4 | Armor | 4/8/16 |
| Wind | 1/2/4 | Animal | 2/4/8 |
| Water | 1/2/4 | Plants | 2/4/8 |
| Blades | 4/8/16 | Energy | 1/2/4 |
| Axes | 4/8/16 | Life | 2/4/8 |
| Polearms | 4/8/16 | Religion | 4/8/16 |
| Archery | 4/8/16 | Mind | 1/2/4 |
| Heavy Weapon | 4/8/16 | Summon | 1/2/4 |
| Unarmed | 4/8/16 | | |

::: {.callout-note}
## Magic Always Fires

There are no spell slots. No mana. No "I'm out of spells." Your magic always goes off. Weak hit? The spell still fires, just not as hard. This changes everything about playing a caster. You're never useless. You're never out of options.
:::

{{< pagebreak >}}

## The Shepherd

*"The light guides my hand."*

The Shepherd stands as a beacon of guidance, providing moral direction and harnessing divine energies to aid allies. Your path is one of enlightenment, using a deep connection to the divine to inspire and protect those around you. Through word and deed, you channel power into abilities that heal, shield, and uplift your companions. Keyed to Reason, your wisdom discerns the right course in the murkiest of situations, offering light in darkness. You also stand as a bulwark against the undead, creatures that have slipped beyond death's reach fear your presence.

**Class Discipline (L1):** Protection (1)

**Signature, Turn Undead:** Call down divine energy that ignores armor and affects only undead creatures within your presence. Your faith burns what should not walk.

**Favored Skills:** Medicine, Nature, Religion, Survival

**Discipline Costs (Rank 1 / Rank 2 / Rank 3):**

| Discipline | Cost | Discipline | Cost |
|------------|------|------------|------|
| Fire | 4/8/16 | Protection | 1/2/4 |
| Earth | 4/8/16 | Armor | 4/8/16 |
| Wind | 4/8/16 | Animal | 1/2/4 |
| Water | 4/8/16 | Plants | 1/2/4 |
| Blades | 3/6/12 | Energy | 2/4/8 |
| Axes | 4/8/16 | Life | 1/2/4 |
| Polearms | 4/8/16 | Religion | 1/2/4 |
| Archery | 4/8/16 | Mind | 2/4/8 |
| Heavy Weapon | 4/8/16 | Summon | 4/8/16 |
| Unarmed | 3/6/12 | | |

::: {.callout-note}
## Healing Matters

Healing in Heroes of Legend is precious. HP recovery is slow outside of magic. A Shepherd in the party changes the calculus of every fight. Your allies will love you. The DA will have to work harder to threaten them.
:::

## The Intellect

*"I've read about this."*

The Intellect embodies cerebral prowess and scholarly mastery. Your path is a relentless pursuit of knowledge, delving into ancient tomes, unlocking the mysteries of the universe. With a mind as sharp as a finely honed blade, you navigate the world through logic and reason. Keyed to Knowledge, you are not defined by brute strength but by cunning and foresight. Through tactical acumen and strategic planning, you outmaneuver foes with calculated precision, turning their own weaknesses against them. Your words carry weight, guiding allies through the darkest times.

**Class Discipline (L1):** Any one (your choice, reflecting your field)

**Signature, Knowledge Is Power:** Gain +1 to all Knowledge-based skill checks. This increases at higher levels.

**Favored Skills:** History, Investigation, Lore (any three), Medicine, Arcana

**Discipline Costs (Rank 1 / Rank 2 / Rank 3):**

| Discipline | Cost | Discipline | Cost |
|------------|------|------------|------|
| Fire | 2/4/8 | Protection | 2/4/8 |
| Earth | 2/4/8 | Armor | 4/8/16 |
| Wind | 2/4/8 | Animal | 2/4/8 |
| Water | 2/4/8 | Plants | 1/2/4 |
| Blades | 3/6/12 | Energy | 1/2/4 |
| Axes | 4/8/16 | Life | 1/2/4 |
| Polearms | 3/6/12 | Religion | 1/2/4 |
| Archery | 3/6/12 | Mind | 1/2/4 |
| Heavy Weapon | 4/8/16 | Summon | 2/4/8 |
| Unarmed | 4/8/16 | | |

::: {.callout-note}
## Stop and Think

The Intellect's secondary ability lets you spend your mobility for the turn to harness pure mental power, gaining insight, revealing weaknesses, or uncovering hidden information. You may not move, but you see what no one else can.
:::

## The Odd

*"I have a trick for that."*

The Odd embodies eccentricity and peculiarity. With a demeanor that dances on the edge of madness and a style that defies convention, you bring chaos and unpredictability to every encounter. Keyed to Guile, your appearance is striking, mismatched clothing, bizarre accessories, an unusual hairstyle. In battle, you are a whirlwind of unorthodox tactics: spells with unconventional gestures, bizarre weapons wielded with deadly precision, strange powers that defy explanation. Your adversaries never know what to expect. Sometimes, neither do you.

**Class Discipline (L1):** Any one, from a **different category** than your ancestry and culture Disciplines (e.g., if you already have Weapon and Defense, take an Elemental or Energy).

**Signature, Eccentric Spellcasting:** Choose one arcane ability and one divine ability. You ignore prerequisite Disciplines for these two (level requirements still apply). You need no arcane focus or holy symbol.

**Favored Skills:** Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Streetwise, Deception, Acrobatics

**Discipline Costs (Rank 1 / Rank 2 / Rank 3):**

Pick 3 Disciplines as Home (1/2/4) at Level 1. Everything else is Adjacent (2/4/8). The Odd has no Opposed costs.

| Discipline | Cost | Discipline | Cost |
|------------|------|------------|------|
| Fire | 2/4/8 | Protection | 2/4/8 |
| Earth | 2/4/8 | Armor | 2/4/8 |
| Wind | 2/4/8 | Animal | 2/4/8 |
| Water | 2/4/8 | Plants | 2/4/8 |
| Blades | 2/4/8 | Energy | 2/4/8 |
| Axes | 2/4/8 | Life | 2/4/8 |
| Polearms | 2/4/8 | Religion | 2/4/8 |
| Archery | 2/4/8 | Mind | 2/4/8 |
| Heavy Weapon | 2/4/8 | Summon | 2/4/8 |
| Unarmed | 2/4/8 | | |

::: {.callout-note}
## You're Also Scary

Once per scene, the Odd can contort their body, speak in tongues, cackle, or otherwise terrify a target they can see. It's unsettling. It's effective. It's very, very you.
:::

## The Leader

*"Together, we are unstoppable."*

The Leader is a beacon of courage on the battlefield, leading from the front lines with valor and resolve. Keyed to Reason, your stirring speeches and tactical acumen rally allies to action, instilling confidence even in the face of adversity. Beyond command, you serve as mentor and confidant, recognizing and nurturing the potential within each member of your group. Driven by a clear vision and unwavering commitment, you guide your companions toward a brighter future. In your presence, unity flourishes.

**Class Discipline (L1):** Protection (1)

**Signature, Lead by Example:** When you land a telling blow on an enemy, grant one ally who witnessed it a +2 bonus on their next roll. Your actions inspire greatness in others.

**Favored Skills:** Persuasion, Resilience, Perception, Insight, Blades skills, Polearms

**Discipline Costs (Rank 1 / Rank 2 / Rank 3):**

| Water | 4/8/16 | Plants | 4/8/16 |
| Blades | 1/2/4 | Energy | 1/2/4 |
| Axes | 2/4/8 | Life | 2/4/8 |
| Polearms | 1/2/4 | Religion | 2/4/8 |

| Heavy Weapon | 2/4/8 | Summon | 4/8/16 |
| Unarmed | 2/4/8 | | |

::: {.callout-note}
## Battle Cry

The Leader's secondary ability is **Battle Cry**, a thunderous shout that grants all allies within earshot a momentary surge of courage. Fear effects are suppressed. Morale is restored. The party remembers why they follow you.
:::

## The Unbalanced

*"Power has a price. I'm willing to pay."*

The Unbalanced is a wild card, embodying chaos and unpredictability in every action. Your demeanor is marked by erratic energy, veering between bouts of laughter and brooding intensity. Behind your unpredictable facade lies a mind that operates on its own unique wavelength, calculating the odds even as you appear to embrace madness. In battle, you unleash pent-up frenzy with ferocious abandon, your fighting style as unpredictable as your personality. You thrive on the chaos of combat, reveling in the uncertainty of the fray.

**Class Discipline (L1):** Any one Elemental (Fire, Earth, Wind, or Water)

**Signature, Edge of Chaos:** On a Strong hit, deal +4 bonus damage but roll on a d6 backlash table, self-damage, a fleeting condition, or an environmental surge that affects everyone, friend and foe alike.

**Favored Skills:** Arcana, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Unarmed Fighting

**Discipline Costs (Rank 1 / Rank 2 / Rank 3):**

Choose two opposing Elemental Disciplines at Level 1 (Fire/Water or Earth/Wind). Those become Home. The other two elements become Opposed.

| Discipline | Cost | Discipline | Cost |
|------------|------|------------|------|
| Fire | 1/2/4 or 4/8/16* | Protection | 4/8/16 |
| Earth | 1/2/4 or 4/8/16* | Armor | 4/8/16 |
| Wind | 1/2/4 or 4/8/16* | Animal | 2/4/8 |
| Water | 1/2/4 or 4/8/16* | Plants | 2/4/8 |
| Blades | 4/8/16 | Energy | 1/2/4 |
| Axes | 4/8/16 | Life | 3/6/12 |
| Polearms | 4/8/16 | Religion | 3/6/12 |
| Archery | 4/8/16 | Mind | 3/6/12 |
| Heavy Weapon | 4/8/16 | Summon | 2/4/8 |
| Unarmed | 1/2/4 | | |

\* Pick two opposing elements as Home (1/2/4); the other two become Opposed (4/8/16).

From Animal, Plants, Summon, Life, Religion, and Mind, pick 2 to be Home (1/2/4), 2 to be Adjacent (2/4/8), and 2 to be Foreign (3/6/12). The costs above show a default distribution; you decide where the chaos bends in your favor.

::: {.callout-note}
## Embrace the Chaos

You're not broken. You're balanced on a knife's edge between opposing forces, and that tension is your source of power. When it works, you're the most dangerous person in the room. When it doesn't, well, that's entertaining too. The party keeps you around because when everything goes wrong, you're the one who knows what to do with wrong.
:::

{{< pagebreak >}}

## The Shadow

*"You never saw me."*

The Shadow is the ghost in the room, the whisper no one heard, the hand that lifts a key from a guard's belt while the guard is still wearing it. Where the Blade wins by stabbing first, the Shadow wins by never being seen at all. You are keyed to Agility and Guile in equal measure, a creature of silence and misdirection. Doors open for you. Traps disarm themselves at your touch. Identities are costumes you wear and discard. Your fighting style is dirty, fast, and never, ever fair. If the fight is fair, you've already made two mistakes, and you're already gone.

**Class Discipline (L1):** Blades (1)

**Signature, Vanish:** As a maneuver, you may attempt to disappear from sight. Make a Stealth check. On Standard+, you become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack. On Weak, you gain concealment instead (attacks against you have Bane). This is not magic, this is being very good at not being noticed.

**Secondary, Shadow Step:** Once per scene, when you Vanish successfully, you may immediately move up to 15 feet without provoking reactions. You appear in your new position when the invisibility ends, ideally behind someone who deserved it.

**Favored Skills:** Stealth, Deception, Sleight of Hand, Thievery, Acrobatics, Perception, Blades skills, Thrown Weapon

**Discipline Costs (Rank 1 / Rank 2 / Rank 3):**

| Discipline | Cost | Discipline | Cost |
|------------|------|------------|------|
| Fire | 4/8/16 | Protection | 4/8/16 |
| Earth | 4/8/16 | Armor | 4/8/16 |
| Wind | 4/8/16 | Animal | 4/8/16 |
| Water | 4/8/16 | Plants | 4/8/16 |
| Blades | 1/2/4 | Energy | 4/8/16 |
| Axes | 4/8/16 | Life | 4/8/16 |
| Polearms | 4/8/16 | Religion | 4/8/16 |
| Archery | 1/2/4 | Mind | 1/2/4 |
| Heavy Weapon | 4/8/16 | Summon | 4/8/16 |
| Unarmed | 2/4/8 | | |

::: {.callout-note}
## The Stealth Economy

The Shadow doesn't trade blows. The Shadow's entire game is about controlling who can see them and who can't. Your turn is spend Maneuver to Vanish, move into position behind the enemy caster, then on your next turn, strike from invisibility with advantage. If things go wrong, you have getaway tools: caltrops, smoke bombs, a disguise kit, and a network of contacts who owe you favors.

Your damage doesn't come from brute force. It comes from never being where the enemy is looking. When the Blade needs three rounds to carve through a knight's armor, the Shadow needs one round, one lockpick, and the knight's potion of healing quietly removed from his belt while he was too busy watching the Protector. You win by making the fight unfair. And you make it unfair before anyone knows you're there.

**Starting Kit:** Two daggers (W/S/S: 1/2/3), throwing knives (6, 1/2/3), leather armor (DR 2), thieves' tools, disguise kit, 50 ft silk rope, grappling hook, smoke bomb (1, creates 10-ft radius heavy concealment for 1 round), 15 sp.
:::

## Class Archetypes {#sec-class-archetypes}

The nine classes cluster into four archetypes, each with its own flavor and its own pool of class abilities. These aren't subclasses, they're families. A Protector and an Unbalanced feel different at the table, but they both solve problems with force. An Arcanist and an Intellect feel different, but they both solve problems with knowledge.

| Archetype | Classes | Ability Pool | Vibe |
|-----------|---------|-------------|------|
| **Mage** | Arcanist, Intellect | 15-20 | Power through knowledge. Spells, wards, the right word at the right time. |
| **Priest** | Shepherd, Leader | 15-20 | Power through faith. Healing, protection, inspiration. |
| **Thief** | Blade, Shadow | 15-20 | Power through precision. Damage, infiltration, the unseen strike. |
| **Fighter** | Protector, Unbalanced | 15-20 | Power through force. Defense, chaos, standing in the gap. |

The **Odd** occupies no archetype. It is the pure wildcard, a deliberately chaotic set of ~10 class abilities that samples all four archetype flavors. A fighter trick here, a mage trick there, a thief trick, a priest trick, and a few things nobody else can do. The Odd is the exception that proves the four-way rule. It doesn't fit. It's not supposed to.

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Class Abilities {#sec-class-abilities}

Every class has a list of abilities unique to it. These are the moves, spells, and tricks that define a hero's identity in play. Abilities are purchased using the flat card cost: 2 DP for Novice, 4 DP for Adept, 8 DP for Master. Their real gate is Discipline prerequisites and level (Adept at 3, Master at 7). Every damaging ability is keyed to the damage budget table in @sec-damage-budget. The full lists are future work; what follows are SEED examples that prove the shape.

### Mage Abilities (Arcanist & Intellect)

**Arcanist**

| Ability | Tier | Disc Req | Trigger | Effect |
|---------|------|----------|---------|--------|
| **Arcane Feedback** | Novice | 1 Energy | When you cast a spell and roll Strong | The spell's secondary target takes half the primary target's damage. |
| **Spell Echo** | Adept | 2 Energy, 1 Mind | When an enemy within 30 ft casts a spell | You may immediately cast the same spell at Novice tier, regardless of your own Disciplines. Once per scene. |
| **Overchannel** | Master | 2 Energy, 1 Fire | When you cast a Master spell | The spell deals +1 damage tier (use the row one step above on the damage budget). After casting, you gain 1 Corruption. |

**Intellect**

| Ability | Tier | Disc Req | Trigger | Effect |
|---------|------|----------|---------|--------|
| **Tactical Insight** | Novice | 1 Mind | At the start of combat | Name one enemy weakness. All allies gain +1 on attacks against that enemy type for the encounter. |
| **Leverage** | Adept | 2 Mind, 1 Energy | When an ally misses an attack | The ally may reroll the miss. If the reroll hits, it deals +3 bonus damage. Once per scene. |
| **Perfect Recall** | Master | 2 Mind, 1 Energy | When you need information from a scene you participated in | The DA must tell you the exact words, layout, or sequence of events, to the limit of your own perception at the time. Once per session. |

### Odd Abilities

The Odd's ~10 abilities are a deliberately chaotic set sampling all four archetypes. They ignore Discipline prerequisites for their two free spells from **Eccentric Spellcasting**, but their Odd class abilities still require Disciplines.

| Ability | Tier | Disc Req | Trigger | Effect |
|---------|------|----------|---------|--------|
| **Improvised Solution** | Novice | No prereq | When you attempt a skill check with a skill you don't have | You roll as if you had Novice (+1) in that skill. Once per scene. |
| **Wrong Context** | Adept | 2 any (different types) | When an enemy declares an action | You may force the enemy to describe their action differently. If the DA deems your version plausible, the enemy's action has Bane. Once per scene. |
| **Everything At Once** | Master | 3 any (across 3 different types) | When you take damage | Roll 1d4. 1: you gain +4 Armor for 1 round. 2: you heal 10 HP. 3: the attacker takes the damage instead. 4: both you and the attacker take the damage. Once per session. |

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Progression

You gain Development Points each level (see @sec-chapter-advancement for the full progression). Spend them all, they don't carry over.

**Adept** abilities unlock at Level 3. **Master** abilities unlock at Level 7. Until then, everything you buy is Novice.

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Costs

Your class determines how expensive each Discipline rank is to purchase. Cards (abilities, spells, skills) have a flat DP cost regardless of class: Novice 2 DP, Adept 4 DP, Master 8 DP. The total cost of a card = its flat card price + the sum of the discipline rank costs for each required discipline.

There are four cost structures, showing the price for rank 1 / rank 2 / rank 3:

| Structure | Rank 1 | Rank 2 | Rank 3 | Meaning |
|-----------|--------|--------|--------|---------|
| **Home** | 1 DP | 2 DP | 4 DP | Favored — core to the class identity |
| **Adjacent** | 2 DP | 4 DP | 8 DP | Related but not core |
| **Foreign** | 3 DP | 6 DP | 12 DP | Unrelated to the class |
| **Opposed** | 4 DP | 8 DP | 16 DP | Out of class — antithetical to the class |
